features.name: Speed (Kobold Chassis)
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Clutch Aide
features.description: Kobolds spend their lives alongside their clutchmates, and you retain much of this group-oriented intuition. You can take the Help action as a bonus action.

payload.name: Clutch Aide
payload.description: Take the Help action as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Resourceful
features.description: If you have at least one set of tools, you can cobble together one set of makeshift tools of a different type with 1 minute of work. The makeshift tools last for 10 minutes then collapse. While the makeshift tools exist, you can't use the tools you used to create them. Creatures other than you using the makeshift tools have disadvantage on the check.
